retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast halftone band portrait featuring a central figure against a radial sunburst background with layered, multi-style typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A grainy, halftone-textured composition featuring a central male figure in high contrast, surrounded by faded band members, all set against a blue and grey radial sunburst. The typography is layered horizontally across the center, mixing bold sans-serif and thin serif styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by radial sunburst lines
Halftone texture unifying disparate photographic elements
Horizontal typographic block cutting across the vertical subject
Duotone color palette creating a cohesive retro mood
coreInvariants: Heavy halftone dot grain across all photographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered and large-scale, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the bold white text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the radial lines inward to the central face, then drop to the horizontal text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture and secondary figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Periwinkle blue in the sunburst and text highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and central figure's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the halftone dots and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mixed: ultra-bold extended sans-serif and high-contrast modern serif.
letterConstructionRules: Primary display text uses extreme horizontal expansion
Secondary text uses thin, elongated vertical strokes
Tertiary text is a small, wide-tracked serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'b' and 'e' in the top row are heavily weighted and squashed.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast: heavy sans-serif paired with delicate, wide-tracked serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, wide geometric feel of the primary text.
Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a halftone-textured collage of a band. The central figure is in high-contrast black and white. The background features a periwinkle and grey radial sunburst pattern. Secondary figures are faded into the background texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of centered text. Top line: ultra-bold white extended sans-serif. Middle line: thin periwinkle serif with wide tracking. Bottom line: small white serif.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone texture visible across all image elements?
Does the sunburst radiate from the center?
Is the top text line significantly wider and bolder than the others?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the halftone effect doesn't obscure the text legibility.
Ensure the radial lines converge behind the central figure's head.
Verify the color palette is limited to the specified tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Halftone Band Portrait + Radial Sunburst + Layered Contrast Typography
